title: New Pass-ta-key attack reveals all the things we didn't know about passkeys
summary: With no confidence that passkeys stored on a Windows device won’t be harvested in the event of a malware infection, many third-party developers opted for a new design—storing the passkeys in end-to-end encrypted blobs located in the cloud.
